items.title: Nigeria’s central bank introduces stablecoin licensing rules, bans algorithmic versions
items.summary: Nigeria's central bank issued new virtual asset regulations requiring stablecoin issuers and other service providers to obtain local licenses.

items.title: Nigeria sets new crypto licensing rules, bans algorithmic stablecoins
items.summary: Nigeria has banned algorithmic stablecoins and introduced reserve requirements for issuers as it expands central bank oversight of crypto payment services.

items.title: Binance hackers had 8-week intrusion window before $6.3B exploit: SEAL
items.summary: The cybersecurity company flagged similar multi-stage intrusion patterns behind other high-profile crypto heists, including the $388 million Bitget hack.

items.title: OpenAI Found 948 Linux Security Flaws—And Figured Out How to Exploit Them
items.summary: An automated OpenAI system produced working exploits and draft fixes at roughly $1,279 per flaw, raising new questions about how cheaply AI can find holes in critical software at scale.

items.title: Binance Hackers Swap About $50 Million of Stolen XRP Mostly Into Bitcoin, Elliptic Says
